learning.title: Vehicle vs shape: when a contract change breaks tests, flip the shape and convert the vehicle - never delete invariants riding the old shape
learning.body:
Night of 2026-11-17, #518 (workflow admission: flat repository runs become refused, cloud_only keeps a structural exception). The PM ruled "flip the failing flat-admission tests to assert the refusal." dev-workflows measured before forcing it and reversed the ruling with evidence: the 201 at :1044 feeds 26 assertions across 656 lines, and what those assertions test is NOT the flat walk - it is admission-agnostic invariants asserted THROUGH a flat run as a vehicle: idempotency replay, one-active-run, 409-on-competing-key, step listing, and the snapshot-immutability spine that is the file's namesake.
Distinction: after a contract change breaks a test, separate its assertions into two kinds - - SHAPE assertions: content that exists only in the deleted form (flat snapshot fields, flat-specific walk). Flipping these to assert the new refusal is asserting the new contract - the honest small edit. - VEHICLE assertions: invariants that ride the old form but are not about it (immutability, idempotency, cardinality, isolation). Flipping the admission deletes these in the same stroke - weakening wearing the right hat. The vehicle must be CONVERTED (same invariants, re-derived snapshot against the new form), which is PR-sized work, not an edit.
Rule: before flipping a broken test, count what its post-201/post-success body asserts. If anything after the changed shape is an admission-agnostic invariant, the test converts, it does not flip. And measure before converting - "flip" sounded small until the 26-uses/656-lines count said otherwise.
Merge-shape corollary (same night): when the conversion is PR-sized, the split-PR alternative (base PR red until a stacked conversion lands) buys bookkeeping and a red window; the lane must be green at the merged head, so the conversion lands as its own commit in the same PR - commit granularity answers the big-diff objection, and the review handoff names the two units.
